title: From ‘Bongga Ka ‘Day’ to bringing a fan onstage, Zara Larsson turns up heat in first PH solo show
summary: Zara Larsson danced to “Bongga Ka ‘Day,” brought a Pinoy fan onstage, and revealed that she experienced sun sickness in 2017 at her first PH solo concert.
